figurative_meaning_en: lazy; inept or clumsy in work
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কাজে একেবারে কুঁড়ে, কিছুই ঠিকমতো করে না।
এই কুঁড়ে ছেলেটি সারাদিন শুয়ে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is completely inept at work; he can't do anything properly.
This lazybones boy lies around all day.
note: The idiom draws from the image of an unopened bud, symbolizing inactivity or lack of development in skills.
